desc:
🔑 Welcome to Escape the Rooms! 🔑

🚪 Can you escape tricky rooms? Each room has a different challenge — from finding hidden keys to dodging lasers, solving puzzles, and even using emotes in creative ways! Play with your friends and see who can escape the fastest!

✅ Join our group to report any bugs you encounter. We’ll fix them as soon as possible! You’ll also get a free bonus item when you join our group!

👍 Don’t forget to like and favorite the game to support future updates and new rooms! ⭐ Group members have access to a free gravity coil!
